guidelineTitle: Методичні вказівки з підготовки та оформлення кваліфікаційних та курсових робіт для студентів факультету комп’ютерних наук та кібернетики. Т. О. Карнаух, Л. Л. Омельчук, А. Б. Ставровський. Київ, 2025. 58 с.
limitations: PDF page 1 is the unnumbered title; PDF pages 2–58 match printed numbers
Pass covers observed literals only, never rendered compliance or real-thesis acceptance
Finite syntax/context allowlist; no macro expansion or include resolution
Source observation only; rendered layout unverified
rules.severityRationale: Mandatory requirement, but literal source intent is not effective TeX state or rendered compliance
rules.supportedSyntax: Top-level unstarred setlength with parindent target and nonnegative decimal mm/cm; <=9 digits and <=3 fractional digits

rules.expected: No terminal U+002E in a literal heading title
limitations: Finite syntax/context allowlist; no macro expansion or include resolution
Source observation only; rendered layout unverified
rules.severityRationale: Mandatory requirement, but literal source intent is not effective TeX state or rendered compliance
rules.supportedSyntax: Top-level chapter/section/subsection/subsubsection/paragraph/subparagraph, optional one star, immediate literal short title and literal display title

rules.expected: At least top/bottom 20 mm, left 25 mm, right 10 mm; no upper bound; rendered geometry unverified
limitations: Finite syntax/context allowlist; no macro expansion or include resolution

All four explicit unique sides required; unknown packages/options, dynamic or nested syntax, duplicate imports/declarations and mixed option/command declarations are indeterminate; no precedence inference
Source observation only; rendered layout unverified; one eligible literal side may be proposed for explicit review
rules.severityRationale: Mandatory minimum margins, but literal source intent is not effective TeX state or rendered compliance
rules.supportedSyntax: Top-level unstarred geometry with four explicit literal side options; or one preamble usepackage{geometry} followed by one geometry declaration; or one usepackage[left/right/top/bottom options]{geometry}. Same nonnegative decimal mm/cm grammar, <=9 digits, <=3 fractional digits and <=4096 argument bytes; immediate lexer-owned optional argument only

rules.severityRationale: Mandatory guideline category, but declared literal source intent is not effective TeX state or physical PDF compliance
rules.expected: Declared A4 intent; A3 requires illustration purpose that source size alone cannot establish
rules.supportedSyntax: Standard article/report/book immediate documentclass options a4paper/a3paper/a5paper/b5paper/letterpaper/legalpaper/executivepaper; geometry command or geometry package options with those names or paper=a4/a3/a5/b5/letter/legal/executive. Example: documentclass[a4paper]{article}
limitations: Missing/dynamic/unknown paper syntax, repeated declarations and custom classes are indeterminate; A3 illustration purpose is never inferred; physical sheet size is unverified
Finite bounded syntax and ownership only; unknown commands, conditions and unresolved includes preserve uncertainty. No automatic fix

rules.severityRationale: Mandatory guideline category, but declared literal source intent is not effective TeX state or physical PDF compliance
rules.expected: Declared one-and-a-half spacing intent, not measured line/baseline geometry
rules.supportedSyntax: Top-level unstarred onehalfspacing; setstretch{1.5}; linespread{1.5}; renewcommand{\baselinestretch}{1.5}. Literal nonnegative decimal scalar, <=9 digits and <=3 fractional digits; no units. Example: usepackage{setspace} followed by onehalfspacing
limitations: onehalfspacing expresses conventional setspace intent (requires one plain preamble setspace import); setstretch also requires that import. linespread/baselinestretch declare nominal factors, not equivalent measured geometry. Missing/custom/dynamic/repeated declarations are indeterminate; fonts, glyph heights and effective baselines are not measured
Finite bounded syntax and ownership only; unknown commands, conditions and unresolved includes preserve uncertainty. No automatic fix

rules.severityRationale: Mandatory guideline category, but declared literal source intent is not effective TeX state or physical PDF compliance
rules.expected: No terminal U+002E in a supported literal figure/table caption title
rules.supportedSyntax: Unstarred caption{literal title} directly inside one ordinary figure or table in document, without placement arguments. Example: begin{figure} caption{Назва.} end{figure}; exact terminal dot only
limitations: Starred captions, optional short titles and float placement arguments are indeterminate; nested/custom environments, dynamic titles, comments inside titles and macro/conditional context are not interpreted. No numbering, prefix, placement, caption presence or rendered layout inference
Finite bounded syntax and ownership only; unknown commands, conditions and unresolved includes preserve uncertainty. No automatic fix
